purpose: Structural comparison of two JSON values: added, removed and changed entries at any depth, with unchanged entries collapsed and long levels paged.
useWhen: Showing how two JSON values differ, such as one run's input against another's or a configuration before and after an edit.
Comparing structured payloads where which key or index changed matters more than line order.

avoidWhen.reason: Comparing text, source code or unified patches.
Showing one JSON value rather than a comparison.
